brand.name: ZWStudio

brand.subheadline: We build worlds, games, and stories.

rules: H1 Ceiling: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl with tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold
Overlines/Kickers: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-[#E50914]
Manifesto/Editorial: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-light text-[#EDEDF2] leading-snug
No center-aligning large paragraphs; use asymmetric left/split balance

entry_surfaces./: cinematic dark hero — kinetic masked headline + live 3D character centerpiece with floating game/AI/render collage fragments, primary CTA cluster left, telemetry status pill top right

layout_and_sections.title: HERO (01 / ENCOUNTER)
layout_and_sections.structure: Split cinematic container with glowing crimson focal center. Left/top: Masked staggered reveal headline 'WE BUILD WORLDS.', subtitle 'Games. AI. Animation.', dual action buttons ('Explore Our Work' [crimson pill with magnetic glide], 'What We Do' [glass outline]). Center/Right: 3D character centerpiece layered with floating glassmorphic fragments representing Roblox game meshes, neural latent space nodes, and 3D wireframe render previews. Micro-telemetry badge: 'STATUS: ACTIVE IN EXPERIMENTAL PRODUCTION'.

layout_and_sections.title: INTRO / MANIFESTO (02 / CREED)
layout_and_sections.structure: Typography-first high-contrast editorial block. Large statement with interactive glowing keyword triggers: 'Games are worlds. Animation is storytelling. AI is a new creative instrument.' Supported by 3-column micro-pillars: 01 Immersion / 02 Velocity / 03 Expressive Craft.

layout_and_sections.title: WHAT WE DO (03 / THREE DISCIPLINES)
layout_and_sections.structure:
Tetris Bento grid highlighting three core creative branches with custom tags and interactive drill-downs:
1. Indie Game Studio: Original Roblox experiences, physics mechanics, live-ops game loops ('Explore Games').
2. AIGC Studio: Concept development, neural character pipelines, generative lore & visual key art ('Explore AI Work').
3. 3D Animation & Shorts: Comedic shorts, high-cadence YouTube/TikTok viral storytelling ('Watch Animation').

layout_and_sections.title: FEATURED WORK (04 / ARCHIVE)
layout_and_sections.structure:
Editorial horizontal-feel or asymmetrical card gallery with tags, progress meters, and preview modal hooks:
- Project 01: 'Project Zero: Realm of Echoes' (Original Roblox Experience — In Development)
- Project 02: 'Latent Flesh & Chrome' (AI Visual Concept & Lore Bible — Experimental)
- Project 03: 'Zero & The Glitch' (Comedic 3D Micro-Shorts Series — Ongoing)

layout_and_sections.title: THE STUDIO (05 / COLLECTIVE)
layout_and_sections.structure: Asymmetrical layout: 'Small team. Big worlds.' Highlighting indie ethos, multidisciplinary pipelines, fast iteration, and zero corporate bureaucracy. Includes stats strip: 100% Original IP, 3 Connected Disciplines, 60fps Pipeline, 0 Corporate Bloat.

layout_and_sections.title: CREATIVE PROCESS (06 / PIPELINE)
layout_and_sections.structure:
Linear 4-step horizontal cyber-timeline with active step highlight:
01 IDEA (Concept & Latent Ideation) → 02 BUILD (Roblox & 3D Prototyping) → 03 CREATE (Animation & Polish) → 04 RELEASE (Multi-Platform Launch).

layout_and_sections.title: CONTENT LAB / SHORTS (07 / BROADCAST)
layout_and_sections.structure: Grid of short-form video cards (9:16 vertical ratio) for YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and Instagram Reels with play button hover glow, comedic titles, duration pills, and view indicators.

layout_and_sections.title: FINAL CTA (08 / CONVERGE)
layout_and_sections.structure: Cinematic full-width punch section. Headline: 'LET\'S BUILD SOMETHING WEIRD.' Dual CTAs: 'Start a Conversation' (mailto:hello@zerowings.studio) and 'See Our Work' (smooth anchor to #featured-work).

layout_and_sections.title: FOOTER (09 / SYSTEM)
layout_and_sections.structure: Rich dark footer with massive outline watermark 'ZERO WINGS', logo badge, discipline index, direct social links (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, Discord, Roblox Group), copy notice: '© 2026 ZWStudio. All worlds reserved.'

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lenis via `yarn add lenis` in `frontend/` for fluid award-winning momentum scrolling.
Import Space Grotesk Variable and JetBrains Mono Variable from `@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk` and `@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono` in `frontend/src/index.css`.
Use crimson red (#E50914) as the intentional brand anchor with electric blue (#0070F3 / #38BDF8) as high-tech secondary accents.
Implement the custom ZWStudio logo component (concentric crimson rings, dark navy wings, '0' mark).
Implement interactive modals/details for all 3 featured projects and an interactive video preview popup for the short-form content lab.
Ensure all buttons, navigation links, filters, and cards have explicit `data-testid` attributes.
Ensure dark mode is locked on `<html class='dark'>` in `frontend/index.html` for cinematic presentation.
Include subtle particle or ambient glowing mesh canvas background in the hero section.
